patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と points back at the words just said, as the thing being said. と いっとろー = 'that's what I'm saying'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: いっとろー is an old-man dialect form of いっているだろう, where ている shows something going on and だろう means 'surely'. いっとろー = 'I've been saying, surely'.

patterns.name: 〜が (sentence-final)
patterns.explanation: が at the very end of an angry sentence adds a scolding 'haven't I!' feeling. いっとろーが = 'I've been telling you, haven't I!'.
